notes.title: Development Release #33
notes.content:
This release includes many fixes and a couple of bigger items:

- Repository: On the title screen, you can now see all the cards in the game. However, some of them have yet to be discovered!
- Custom game seed: Before you start a new run, you can customize the game seed to whatever you'd like (currently this is limited to 8 characters, however this might go away).
- Fix shop: The shop didn't contain any cards to buy! Now, there's cards in it. We haven't fully decided how those cards are picked, but at least you can buy some.
- Event log: During a fight, there's now an Event Log that contains all the things that are happening during a fight. This should make it easier to follow and understand what's going on in a fight.
- Deadshot card fix: Deadshot can now be cancelled and played again. Thanks, Robin.

Generally, this release contains a lot of new features that need to be ironed out in the coming releases.

notes.title: Fixes, nothing but fixes.
notes.content:
This update focuses on fixes, not features:

[list]
[*] Boosters can now only be enabled during the player's turn.
[*] Set HP of Matriarch enemy to 122/122.
[*] Show a popup if the settings couldn't be loaded succesfully.
[*] Fix card hover sound not always playing during a fight.
[*] Fix gigantic bug where certain cards have been basically played twice (e.g.: Combust).
[*] Fix another gigantic bug in damage calculations. If the enemy had shields that were higher than the damage being dealt, all of the shields got removed. Urghs.
[*] No longer show a red background in health bars. This has been broken for quite a while and will be re-added when the visuals of the game are getting more clear.
[*] Show card type on each card.
[/list]

Thanks to all the playtesters! <3 uwu

notes.title: Cargo :-)
notes.content:
This release brings several improvements, but most notably a new map node: Cargo!
Cargo nodes are basically rewards you can find on the map, plus bosses also drop them!

Alongside that, there's a lot of internal reworking going on:

[list]
[*] Better map layouting
[*] Reduced the number of autoloaded scripts which should improve the initial loading time
[*] Fight rewards now contain random cards based on a weighted probably: That means that common cards are most likely to be rewarded and rare cards the least. This weighting changes based on the fight. If you beat a boss, all cards will be rare!
[/list]

Better map layouting

tags.balance_change: Reduced the number of autoloaded scripts which should improve the initial loading time

Fight rewards now contain random cards based on a weighted probably: That means that common cards are most likely to be rewarded and rare cards the least. This weighting changes based on the fight. If you beat a boss, all cards will be rare!

notes.title: Better UX!
notes.content:
This release focuses on improving the UX, hopefully making the game easier to play:

[list]
[*] Highlight "End turn" button when no cards can be played.
[*] Fight rewards: Gold is now collected automatically.
[*] Fight rewards: Removed confirmation of empty screen.
[*] No longer show the "Discard a card" prompt when you have no cards to discard!
[*] Add tooltips to the most important elements on the fight screen. 
[/list]

Thank to all my playtesters!

notes.title: Gameplay fixes!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Completely reworked the damage system.
[*] Fixed combust: It now reduces the players health by 1 correctly. That is, it's ignoring effects on the player.
[*] The damage on cards now show whether they are affected by Buffs/Debuffs or not by highlighting their damage value in bright green. This is for hand cards only.
[*] Buffs/Debuffs should decay correctly now. Note that some Buffs/Debuffs don't decay.
[*] Technical: Upgraded to Godot 4.1.2.
[/list]

notes.content:

[*] Added a persistent feedback button the left edge of the screen.
[*] You can no longer "click through" the card grid onto the map. Thanks Victor.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest fixes!
notes.content:
This release includes fixes brought to our attention by our playtesters!

[list]
[*] Clicking on the boss on the map starts the boss fight
[*] The settings can now be accessed from the pause menu
[*] Audio settings are now probably restored when first launching the game
[*] Toggling pause using the "Resume" button properly works now
[*] Beginnings of UI unification: Buttons should all look more coherent now
[/list]

This is still early in development. Thanks to everyone who tested and continues
to help us make the game better.

notes.title: Fullscreen mode can be switched off
notes.content:
Added an option to disable fullscreen mode to the settings screen.

There's a known issue when you switch from fullscreen to windowed mode: The mouse pointer of the operationg system will be displayed until the game window loses and regains focus. This is a bug in Godot.
